# function: organizations_organizationalunit

Builds the ARN for `organizations` `organizationalunit`:

```
arn:${Partition}:organizations::${Account}:ou/o-${OrganizationId}/ou-${OrganizationalUnitId}
```

The partition, region and account fields come from the configuration file (`.arn.hcl`, or the path in `ARN_CONFIG`). The remaining placeholders are the arguments, in template order.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# arn:aws:organizations::111111111111:ou/o-organization-id/ou-organizational-unit-id
output "organizations_organizationalunit" {
  value = provider::arn::organizations_organizationalunit("organization-id", "organizational-unit-id")
}
```

## Signature

<!-- signature generated by tfplugindocs -->
```text
organizations_organizationalunit(organization_id string, organizational_unit_id string, options map of string...) string
```

## Arguments

<!-- arguments generated by tfplugindocs -->
1. `organization_id` (String) Value for `${OrganizationId}` in the ARN template.
1. `organizational_unit_id` (String) Value for `${OrganizationalUnitId}` in the ARN template.
<!-- variadic argument generated by tfplugindocs -->
1. `options` (Variadic, Map of String) Optional overrides: `account` (the name of an `account` block in the configuration file), `account_id` (a literal account id), `region` and `partition`. At most one options map may be given. An unrecognized key, or a value set to an empty string, is an error; omit an option, or set it to `null`, to use the default.
